text.text: - 1. 출품하는 모든 제안서는 참가자의 순수 창작물이어야 합니다.
text.class_id: div:#contents > div:#printArea > div:contest_outline > dl: > dd: > p:

text.text: - 2. 제안서는 제안한 브랜드사에게 전달되며, 모든 제출물은 일체 반환하지 않습니다.
text.class_id: div:#contents > div:#printArea > div:contest_outline > dl: > dd: > p:

text.text: - 3. 참여 작품 수 및 작품 품질 등의 사유로 시상 내역은 변동될 수 있습니다.
text.class_id: div:#contents > div:#printArea > div:contest_outline > dl: > dd: > p:

text.text: - 4. 타인의 권리를 침해하거나 표절한 작품은 수상에서 제외되며, 수상작 선정 이후에 표절 사실이 밝혀지더라도 수상은 취소되고, 시상 내역은 환수 조치합니다.
text.class_id: div:#contents > div:#printArea > div:contest_outline > dl: > dd: > p:

text.text: - 5. 모든 참여자는 제 3자의 초상권, 지적재산권 등 기타 제반 권리를 침해하지 않도록 주의 의무를 다해야 하며,
text.class_id: div:#contents > div:#printArea > div:contest_outline > dl: > dd: > p:

text.text: 이에 대한 이의 신청 또는 분쟁 발생 시 모든 책임은 응모자에게 있습니다.
text.class_id: div:#contents > div:#printArea > div:contest_outline > dl: > dd: > p:

text.text: - 6. 타 공모에 동일 또는 유사 작품을 출품하여 입상한 경우, 입상은 취소되고 상금은 환수됩니다.
text.class_id: div:#contents > div:#printArea > div:contest_outline > dl: > dd: > p:

text.text: - 7. 심사 및 평가 점수는 비공개이며, 심사 결과에 대해 이의 제기할 수 없습니다.
text.class_id: div:#contents > div:#printArea > div:contest_outline > dl: > dd: > p:

text.text: - 8. 심사 기준에 적합한 응모작이 없을 경우, 시상은 제외될 수 있습니다.
text.class_id: div:#contents > div:#printArea > div:contest_outline > dl: > dd: > p:

text.text: - 9. 팀 참가 시, 상금은 팀 대표자에게 지급되며 주최 기관은 팀원의 상금 배분 문제에 관여하지 않습니다.

text.text: 👋🛳️ Ahoy, welcome to Kaggle! You’re in the right place.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > h2:

text.text: This is the legendary Titanic ML competition – the best, first challenge for you to dive into ML competitions and familiarize yourself with how the Kaggle platform works.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: If you want to talk with other users about this competition, come join our Discord! We've got channels for competitions, job postings and career discussions, resources, and socializing with your fellow data scientists. Follow the link here: https://discord
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: The competition is simple: use machine learning to create a model that predicts which passengers survived the Titanic shipwreck.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: Read on or watch the video below to explore more details. Once you’re ready to start competing, click on the "Join Competition button to create an account and gain access to the competition data . Then check out Alexis Cook’s Titanic Tutorial that walks yo
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:
div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > h2:

text.text: The sinking of the Titanic is one of the most infamous shipwrecks in history.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: On April 15, 1912, during her maiden voyage, the widely considered “unsinkable” RMS Titanic sank after colliding with an iceberg. Unfortunately, there weren’t enough lifeboats for everyone onboard, resulting in the death of 1502 out of 2224 passengers and
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: While there was some element of luck involved in surviving, it seems some groups of people were more likely to survive than others.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: In this challenge, we ask you to build a predictive model that answers the question: “what sorts of people were more likely to survive?” using passenger data (ie name, age, gender, socio-economic class, etc).
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:
div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > blockquote: > h4:

text.text: We highly recommend Alexis Cook’s Titanic Tutorial that walks you through making your very first submission step by step and this starter notebook to get started.
text.class_id: div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > blockquote: > p:
div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > h2:

text.class_id: div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > ol: > li:

text.text: Get to Work Download the data, build models on it locally or on Kaggle Notebooks (our no-setup, customizable Jupyter Notebooks environment with free GPUs) and generate a prediction file.
text.class_id: div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > ol: > li:

text.text: Make a Submission Upload your prediction as a submission on Kaggle and receive an accuracy score.
text.class_id: div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > ol: > li:

text.text: You may run into unfamiliar lingo as you dig into the Kaggle discussion forums and public notebooks. Check out Dr. Rachael Tatman’s video on Kaggle Lingo to get up to speed!
text.class_id: div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > blockquote: > p:

text.text: What Data Will I Use in This Competition?
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > h2:

text.text: In this competition, you’ll gain access to two similar datasets that include passenger information like name, age, gender, socio-economic class, etc. One dataset is titled train.csv and the other is titled test.csv .
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: Train.csv will contain the details of a subset of the passengers on board (891 to be exact) and importantly, will reveal whether they survived or not, also known as the “ground truth”.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: The test.csv dataset contains similar information but does not disclose the “ground truth” for each passenger. It’s your job to predict these outcomes.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: Using the patterns you find in the train.csv data, predict whether the other 418 passengers on board (found in test.csv ) survived.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: Check out the “Data” tab to explore the datasets even further. Once you feel you’ve created a competitive model, submit it to Kaggle to see where your model stands on our leaderboard against other Kagglers.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: How to Submit your Prediction to Kaggle
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > h2:

text.text: Once you’re ready to make a submission and get on the leaderboard:
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:
div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > ol: > li:

text.text: Upload a CSV file in the submission file format. You’re able to submit 10 submissions a day.
text.class_id: div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > ol: > li:
div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > h2:

text.text: You should submit a csv file with exactly 418 entries plus a header row. Your submission will show an error if you have extra columns (beyond PassengerId and Survived ) or rows.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: Kaggle doesn’t have a dedicated team to help troubleshoot your code so you’ll typically find that you receive a response more quickly by asking your question in the appropriate forum. The forums are full of useful information on the data, metric, and diffe

text.text: A Last Word on Kaggle Notebooks
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > h2:

text.text: As we mentioned before, Kaggle Notebooks is our no-setup, customizable, Jupyter Notebooks environment with free GPUs and a huge repository of community published data & code.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: In every competition, you’ll find many Notebooks shared with incredible insights. It’s an invaluable resource worth becoming familiar with. Check out this competition’s Notebooks here .

text.text: It is your job to predict if a passenger survived the sinking of the Titanic or not. For each in the test set, you must predict a 0 or 1 value for the variable.

text.text: Your score is the percentage of passengers you correctly predict. This is known as accuracy .

text.text: What is a Getting Started competition?
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > h2:

text.text: Getting Started competitions were created by Kaggle data scientists for people who have little to no machine learning background. They are a great place to begin if you are new to data science or just finished a MOOC and want to get involved in Kaggle.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: Getting Started competitions are a non-competitive way to get familiar with Kaggle’s platform, learn basic machine learning concepts, and start meeting people in the community. They have no cash prize and are on a rolling timeline.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: How do I create and manage a team?
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > h2:

text.text: When you accept the competition rules, a team will be created for you. You can invite others to your team, accept a merger with another team, and update basic information like team name by going to the More > Team page.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: We've heard from many Kagglers that teaming up is the best way to learn new skills AND have fun. If you don't have a teammate already, consider asking if anyone wants to team up in the discussion forum .
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:
div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > h2:

text.text: Kaggle Notebooks is a cloud computational environment that enables reproducible and collaborative analysis. Notebooks support scripts in Python and R, Jupyter Notebooks, and RMarkdown reports. You can visit the Notebooks tab to view all of the publicly sha
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: Why did my team disappear from the leaderboard?
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > h2:

text.text: To keep with the spirit of getting-started competitions, we have implemented a two month rolling window on submissions. Once a submission is more than two months old, it will be invalidated and no longer count towards the leaderboard.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: If your team has no submissions in the previous two months, the team will also drop from the leaderboard. This will keep the leaderboard at a manageable size, freshen it up, and prevent newcomers from getting lost in a sea of abandoned scores.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: "I worked so hard to get that score! Give it back!" Read more about our decision to implement a rolling leaderboard here .
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: Kaggle does not have a dedicated support team so you’ll typically find that you receive a response more quickly by asking your question in the appropriate forum. (For this competition, you’ll want to use the Titanic discussion forum) .
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: Support is only able to help with issues that are being experienced by all participants. Before contacting support, please check the discussion forum for information on your problem. If you can’t find it, you can post your problem in the forum so a fellow

text.text: If your problem persists or it seems to be effective all participants then please contact us .

text.text: Welcome to the year 2912, where your data science skills are needed to solve a cosmic mystery. We've received a transmission from four lightyears away and things aren't looking good.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: The Spaceship Titanic was an interstellar passenger liner launched a month ago. With almost 13,000 passengers on board, the vessel set out on its maiden voyage transporting emigrants from our solar system to three newly habitable exoplanets orbiting nearby
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: While rounding Alpha Centauri en route to its first destination—the torrid 55 Cancri E—the unwary Spaceship Titanic collided with a spacetime anomaly hidden within a dust cloud. Sadly, it met a similar fate as its namesake from 1000 years before. Though th
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #description > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: To help rescue crews and retrieve the lost passengers, you are challenged to predict which passengers were transported by the anomaly using records recovered from the spaceship’s damaged computer system.

text.text: Getting Started competitions are a non-competitive way to get familiar with Kaggle’s platform, learn basic machine learning concepts, and start meeting people in the community. They have no cash prize and are on a rolling timeline.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: How do I create and manage a team?
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > h3:

text.text: When you accept the competition rules, a team will be created for you. You can invite others to your team, accept a merger with another team, and update basic information like team name by going to the Team page.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: We've heard from many Kagglers that teaming up is the best way to learn new skills AND have fun. If you don't have a teammate already, consider asking if anyone wants to team up in the discussion forum .
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: Kaggle Notebooks is a cloud computational environment that enables reproducible and collaborative analysis. Notebooks support scripts in Python and R, Jupyter Notebooks, and RMarkdown reports. You can visit the Notebooks tab to view all of the publicly sha
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: Why did my team disappear from the leaderboard?
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > h3:

text.text: To keep with the spirit of getting-started competitions, we have implemented a two month rolling window on submissions. Once a submission is more than two months old, it will be invalidated and no longer count towards the leaderboard.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: If your team has no submissions in the previous two months, the team will also drop from the leaderboard. This will keep the leaderboard at a manageable size, freshen it up, and prevent newcomers from getting lost in a sea of abandoned scores.
text.class_id: div:sc-jWqJCk #frequently-asked-questions > div:sc-iBjNZB jenLZQ sc-dlWnaI dYcHIG > div: > div:sc-gDuYws cZNjdZ > div:sc-eGZRwK ebObuk > p:

text.text: "I worked so hard to get that score! Give it back!" Read more about our decision to implement a rolling leaderboard here .

text.text: Kaggle does not have a dedicated support team so you’ll typically find that you receive a response more quickly by asking your question in the appropriate forum. (For this competition, you’ll want to use the Spaceship Titanic discussion forum ).

text.text: 기계 학습 (機械學習) 또는 머신 러닝 ( 영어 : machine learning, ML )은 경험을 통해 자동으로 개선하는 컴퓨터 알고리즘 의 연구이다. [ 1 ] 방대한 데이터 를 분석해 '미래를 예측하는 기술'이자 인공지능 의 한 분야로 간주된다. 기계 학습은 복잡한 패턴에 대한 학습을 통해 상황에 대한 예측과 의사 결정을 돕는다. [ 2 ] 컴퓨터 가 학습할 수 있도록 하는 알고리즘 과 기술을 개발하는 분야이다. 가령, 기계 학습을 통해서 수신한

text.text: 기계 학습의 핵심은 표현(representation)과 일반화(generalization)에 있다. 표현이란 데이터의 평가이며, 일반화란 아직 알 수 없는 데이터에 대한 처리이다. 이는 전산 학습 이론 분야이기도 하다. 다양한 기계 학습의 응용이 존재한다. 문자 인식 은 이를 이용한 가장 잘 알려진 사례이다.
